name: @drawpaper/mobile-capacitor
description: drawpaper tablet shell (Capacitor). PWA-first; this folder only owns the native wrapper config and a reference HostAdapter mapping. Not part of the root pnpm workspace.
//: Standalone package, NOT in root pnpm-workspace.yaml (which only globs packages/*).
Install here in isolation when wiring native builds: pnpm i --ignore-workspace.
webDir points at ../../packages/web/dist; run `pnpm -r build` at repo root first.
This commit ships the PWA-first strategy: iPad/Android users install the PWA; the
Capacitor wrapper is only needed once we want app-store listings (planning §4.12).
